notes: Both `לִפְנֵי` phrases meet rule 30's one-rendering condition — the ASV spends a single *before* on the preposition and its construct noun together — and each is headed on the construct under rule 23. Rule 30 states that a pronominal suffix on such a construct noun is no part of the fusion, so each `וֹ` takes the written *him* under rule 18.
`אֶשְׁפֹּךְ` → *I pour out* keeps *out* with the verb under rule 44: *pour* alone does not write the whole lexeme of `שָׁפַךְ`, so the particle is not the surplus that rule marks `added`.

Word order differs between the cola — the second colon fronts `צָרָתִי` before `לְפָנָיו אַגִּיד` while the English writes *I show before him my trouble* — and the units are reordered under rule 25 rather than re-cut.
